description: This is a Java Spring Boot REST controller class named AuthController that handles authentication-related endpoints such as login and registration. It communicates with AuthService for business logic and uses DTOs for request and response data.

classes.name: AuthController
classes.description: Spring REST controller providing authentication and user registration endpoints with integrated Swagger documentation.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Handles user login requests, authenticates via AuthService, and returns JWT token wrapped in ResponseEntity.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Handles user registration, creates new user via AuthService, and returns user details in ResponseEntity.
